title: jacobaea × mirabilis
intro: Jacobaea × mirabilis, commonly known as Tansy Ragwort, is a hybrid plant species within the Asteraceae family, resulting from the cross between Jacobaea maritima and Jacobaea vulgaris. The plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, particularly in treating digestive issues, such as indigestion and bloating, due to its anti-inflammatory properties. Tansy Ragwort's therapeutic actions include its ability to act as a carminative, helping to relieve flatulence and gas, and as a diaphoretic, inducing sweating to reduce fever. The bioactive constituents of Jacobaea × mirabilis include sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, as well as other compounds such as alkaloids and flavonoids.
